entries.name: Panda
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets); stylized size: 0.9 m tall, about a real giant panda's height on all fours (0.6-0.8 m at the shoulder, the head a little higher), so it sits under the library's cow (1.5 m) and beside a 1.7 m adult's hip; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: Wave-1 row 17 named the Panda from Quaternius's Animated Animals on poly.pizza, which sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (and Quaternius's Google Drive is quota-blocked), so it is unreachable. Two reachable CC0 pandas were rendered: the Panda from Quaternius's Textured Cute Monster Pack (Aug 2020, OpenGameArt) and this one from Kenney Cube Pets. The monster-pack panda is a head-shaped blob with no legs, and its painted grey texture clusters into 17 near-identical greys that scatter the eye patches over the face, so it does not read as a panda in the cel look. The Cube Pets panda has clean black eye patches, ears, shoulder band and legs on white, and reads as a panda at a glance; it is deliberately blocky. Colour map flattened to 24 clusters: the 14 slate clusters (#3d-#52) -> patch, the 10 white clusters -> fur. Ground: run is a hop (in the air up to 5 cm between strides, as authored) and clamps so the landings never sink; walk is a bouncy trot that never sinks and is left as authored; eat lets the snout dip (sinkAllowed). Ingested through Blender like the other Cube Pets (the gltf route cannot load the external colormap.png in Node and would not flatten it).
